offers.title: A Debt at the Casino
offers.body: “The Blue Hour needs a payment collected discreetly. A bookmaker left a sealed envelope under the counter last night, but the owner is too nervous to collect it himself. I need someone who can take it without drawing attention. You’ve handled quiet jobs before, and I trust you to keep it that way.”
offers.speaker: mara

offers.title: A Payment in the Shadows
offers.body: “The Bluebird Laundry has a payment waiting for them, but the owner is too scared to collect it. I need someone who can take it without drawing attention. You’ve done this before, and I trust you to keep it quiet. If you handle this, I’ll make sure the owner gets a better deal next time.”
offers.speaker: mara

offers.title: A Payment Owed at the Laundry
offers.body: I need you to collect a payment owed by a customer at the Bluebird Laundry. They’ve been delaying their payments for weeks, and I can’t afford to let this slide. I don’t want any trouble—just retrieve what’s due and bring it back discreetly. This is a small matter, but it’s important to me.
offers.speaker: mara
